text:
annie-sec: JW (auditor_jw) pinged — they want a small bundle of artifacts for the scoped fieldwork: RBAC delta for service account `svc-inference-runner`, the API call logs that show the change, and a proof that KMS never exposed plaintext. deadline is EOD today.

devon-dev: can do. which time window should we scope? last 7 days or last commit window only?

annie-sec: auditor asked for the commit window + 24h after. so include the PR that triggered the role edit and the deployment job logs. keep it minimal.

mike-oncall: note — our infra retention for detailed API traces is 30 days; sampling is on for debug-level payloads. we should export full traces for that exact window to S3, then provide hash + signed manifest.

jordan-eng: creating export job. ops-bot help? @ops-bot can you kick off an export for svc-inference-runner from 2026-03-18T15:12:00Z to 2026-03-19T15:12:00Z and put it in `s3://redwood-audit/7800012345-audit-bundle/`? include k8s-audit, authz-decisions, and API-gateway logs.

ops-bot: export job created — job-id: export-7800012345-01. ETA ~8m. will post presigned URL when ready. :white_check_mark:

devon-dev: for KMS proof, auditor_jw requested the envelope metadata and key-id usage logs (not plaintext). we can include KMS CloudTrail entries showing Encrypt/Decrypt calls and the KMS key ARN. is that acceptable?

auditor_jw: yes, that works. we need: 1) CloudTrail KMS events for the key used (timestamped), 2) the S3 object checksums and a signature from your security team, and 3) the RBAC patch and resulting access check logs that show deny/allow transitions. hashes over the exported bundle suffice.

annie-sec: we'll provide sha256 for each artifact and an HMAC signed manifest from our SOC key. mike — can you attach the manifest once export finishes?

mike-oncall: will do. also flag: the service account change was rolled out via canary — include the canary rollout timeline and the canary/primary differentials. small snippet of the RBAC patch below: 

```diff
- rolebinding inference-runner-role -> group: inference-readers
+ rolebinding inference-runner-role -> group: inference-runners
+ apiGroups: ["apps"]
+ resources: ["deployments"]
+ verbs: ["get","list","watch","patch"]
```

sana-ml: FYI the change added patch rights so the service can rotate local KV caches. we validated no other privileges were expanded. ran a quick policy audit with OPA.

devon-dev: export job finished. ops-bot posted URL.

ops-bot: export ready: https://s3-presigned.redwood/audit/7800012345-audit-bundle.tar.gz?sig=XXX (expires in 7d). sha256: 3b7f...c9e1.

mike-oncall: attached manifest (signed) and HMAC: MANIFEST_SHA256=3b7f...c9e1; SIG_MANIFEST=MEUCIQDx...; signed-by=annie-sec. Also included CloudTrail KMS entries (timestamps + RequestParameters.keyId), and a short chain-of-custody note.

annie-sec: auditor_jw — sending the bundle via secure transfer now. let us know if you need the raw CloudTrail events (we redacted user-agent of internal ops tools) or a live call to walk through the artifacts.

auditor_jw: thank you. I can accept the bundle and signatures. one quick question: do you have alerts configured for anomalous KMS Decrypt patterns for that key? we may follow up with a sample of alerts.

annie-sec: yes — the key has anomaly monitoring and an alerting rule (sig: KMS-DECRYPT-ANOMALY-v2) that fires to pager after thresholds. I can include a screenshot of the rule and last firing history (none in the window).

auditor_jw: perfect. final ask: please include a short note on your rollback/fallback policy if the RBAC change caused an incident. auditor needs the runbook pointer.

jordan-eng: runbook link: https://confluence.redwood/release-runbooks/rbac-rollback (we'll export a snapshot page). short note: canary -> immediate rollback to previous rolebinding via `kubectl apply -f rolebinding-prev.yaml` and automatic traffic cutover within 2 minutes.

annie-sec: thanks everyone. i'll bundle: export URL, sha256, signed manifest, KMS CloudTrail snippet, canary timeline, RBAC diff, OPA policy results, and runbook excerpt. sending to auditor_jw within the hour. :thumbsup:

mike-oncall: FYI I've tagged the export with internal evidence-id EVID-20260318-7800012345 for tracking.

devon-dev: leaving a quick command snippet for reproducibility: 

```bash
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-audit/7800012345-audit-bundle.tar.gz . && sha256sum 7800012345-audit-bundle.tar.gz
# verify signature
openssl dgst -sha256 -verify soc_pub.pem -signature manifest.sig manifest.json
```

annie-sec: closing loop after I get confirmation from auditor_jw. if they request raw traces we'll coordinate with oncall.

auditor_jw: received. all good for now, will reach out if needed during fieldwork. thanks for the quick turnaround.
